Read /data/data/com.termux/files/home/rea/swipewipe/inputs/task2.md and carry it out exactly.
The APK, jadx MCP jar, 52-class inventory and a validated driver are already staged in ~/rea/swipewipe.
Critical: your foreground bash tool HANGS on long commands on this device. Launch every slow command as
`setsid nohup ... > ~/rea/swipewipe/logs/x.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &` and poll with short commands only.
Do not re-copy base.apk, do not download anything, do not modify or reinstall the app. Append to progress.jsonl
at each step. Finish by writing HANDOFF.md with file:line citations, and state honestly if anything is unfinished.
